$comment: Font manifest. Binaries are NEVER in the repo (licence: no redistribution, hosting or extraction). BW_FONT_DIR is the font root (env, or fontDir in the gitignored .local/config.json). Under it each family folder holds otf/, woff2/ and a local ttf/ made with otf-to-ttf.py; ttf/ is searched first because Chrome prints CFF outlines (.otf/.woff2) as Type 3. ${VAR} expands from the environment.

Thmanyah Serif Display.use: cover title, headings, chapter chips, spine code

Thmanyah Sans.use: editor interface only; not used in documents

weightUse.300: only where a design already uses a light weight

uploadSlot: fonts/custom/ (gitignored; only its README is tracked)
